review: 702.193b-1: variant two_forests flipped legality only by removing mana, not by the reduction rule, and Forests let the base pass even if colored reduction were wrong; switched the lands to three Plains and replaced the variant with Gamma Grotesque, whose {2} cannot reduce the second {G} of its power-up cost.

scenarios.title: A power-up ability costs less if the permanent entered this turn and can be activated only once

setup.notes: Hulk's power-up ability is '{6}{R}{G}: put five +1/+1 counters on Hulk'. summoning_sick true for Hulk means it entered the battlefield this turn.

decisions: A activates Hulk's power-up ability, paying with three Forests.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: entered_this_turn
variants.expected: The activation is legal at the reduced cost {3}. Hulk gets five +1/+1 counters and is an 11/10.

variants.label: entered_on_earlier_turn
variants.delta: Hulk entered the battlefield on an earlier turn (not summoning sick).
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: the cost stays {6}{R}{G} and three Forests cannot pay it. Hulk gets no counters.

variants.label: already_activated
variants.delta: Hulk's power-up ability was already activated once (Hulk has five +1/+1 counters).
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: a power-up ability can be activated only once. Hulk keeps its five counters (11/10).

scenarios.forge_notes: Hulk's own ReduceCost static ability applies only to other creatures.

scenarios.title: The permanent's mana cost reduces the matching generic, colored and colorless mana of the power-up cost

setup.notes: Hulk's mana cost is {3}{R}{G}; its power-up cost is {6}{R}{G}. Gamma Grotesque's mana cost is {2}{G}; its power-up cost is {4}{G}{G}. summoning_sick true means the creature entered the battlefield this turn.

decisions: A checks the cost and legality of the creature's power-up activation with three Plains.

variants.label: hulk_colors_match
variants.expected: The cost after adjustment is {3}: Hulk's {R} and {G} remove the {R}{G} of the power-up cost and Hulk's {3} removes 3 of the {6}. Three Plains pay it, so the activation is legal.

variants.label: gamma_grotesque_extra_green
variants.delta: A's creature is Gamma Grotesque (mana cost {2}{G}, power-up {4}{G}{G}), also entered this turn, instead of Hulk.
variants.expected: The cost after adjustment is {2}{G}: Gamma Grotesque's {G} removes one {G} and its {2} removes only generic mana, so one {G} remains. Three Plains cannot pay {G}, so the activation is not legal.

scenarios.forge_notes: Hulk's mana cost never exceeds the colored part of its power-up cost, so the 'excess reduces generic' branch of 702.193b cannot be reached with any card Forge implements.
